Transcribes recorded audio and video, with speaker labels, redaction and subtitles.

## API key

1. Open [assemblyai.com](https://www.assemblyai.com/dashboard/home) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** The API key from your AssemblyAI dashboard.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add assemblyai
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  assemblyai: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls AssemblyAI's [API](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show assemblyai` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Per hour of audio submitted: Universal-3.5 Pro $0.21, Universal-2 $0.15; the free tier covers up to 185 hours of pre-recorded audio.

**Rate limits:** 4000 a minute. 20,000 requests per 5 minutes per account; 5 transcriptions in parallel on free accounts, 200 or more on paid.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20AssemblyAI).
